# Contribution Checklist

Thank you for your contribution!

Before submitting this pull request, please confirm the following:

- [ ] I certify that this contribution is my original work, or I have permission to submit it.
- [ ] I have read and agree to the **Contributor Terms** in
  `CONTRIBUTOR_LICENSE_AGREEMENT.md`.
- [ ] I understand that my contribution will be licensed under the repository's
  AGPL terms.

By checking these boxes, you confirm that your contribution can be included in
the project.
